title: op
description: One op call with its arguments: run on every apply, or with `unless` only until a read op says it is done (then it converges like any kind). The escape hatch for what has no kind yet.

name.description: this step's id (unique among op documents)

unless.description: a read op whose answer means done: e.g. {op: assets.list, args: {path: /Game/Demo/MH, cls: Blueprint}} (done when the list is not empty)

op.description: area.verb of a read op (mutates false)

has.description: a dotted path into the answer that must be truthy (default: the whole answer)
